planned_by: Claude (Critic): v1.0 criterion 3 (signed proof on a live PR)
goal:
T32 — a verified PR carries its proof: a signed certificate summary and a public /verify link (roadmap M3).

Today _pr_core (services/api/main.py) writes only gate verdicts and the evidence id into the PR body; a reviewer has to
trust EvoForge. T27 made certificates Ed25519-signed (proof.mint / proof.verify, GET /v1/proof/{evidence_id},
GET /v1/proof/key).

1. Factor the certificate minting in proof_certificate() into a helper `_mint_proof(evidence_id) -> dict` and use it
   from both GET /v1/proof/{id} (unchanged response) and _pr_core.
2. In _pr_core, after the gates pass and before github.create_pr, mint the certificate for source_evidence_id and append a
   "Proof" section to the PR body:
   - Verify link: f"{EVO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL}/verify/{source_evidence_id}" (env EVO_PUBLIC_WEB_URL, no trailing slash; when
     unset use the relative path /verify/{id});
   - when signed: "Ed25519", certificate_id, verdict, public key fingerprint (first 16 chars of the base64 public key)
     and the full base64 signature on its own line labelled "Signature:";
   - when unsigned: the line "Proof certificate: unsigned (signing not configured)" and no signature-like text.
3. Store the certificate summary (certificate_id, algorithm, signed, signature, public_key fingerprint) in the PR evidence
   via store_extra so GET /v1/evidence/{pr_evidence_id} shows it.
4. Blocked gates still return 409 before any certificate or PR call.
5. infra is not yours: do not edit infra/. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t32.py.
